groups.label: Sign-in email
groups.help: Slate emails people a link to sign in. Managed hosting sends these for you. Free and Assisted hosting send them through your own Resend or SendGrid account. On your own computer no mail is sent and you sign in with one click.

groups.label: Sign-in security
groups.help: Random keys Slate creates for you. Nobody needs to type or keep them.

groups.label: For developers
groups.help: Leave these as they are unless you are developing Slate itself. Everyday settings, such as who can see what, live inside Slate.

fields.name: APP_NAME
fields.label: App name
fields.help: What sign-in and invitation email call this app, as the sender and in the subject. Leave blank to call it Slate.

fields.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
fields.label: Who sends sign-in email
fields.help: Managed hosting chooses this for you. Free and Assisted hosting need a Resend or SendGrid account.

options.label: Nobody: on this computer only (for developers)

fields.name: MAIL_FROM
fields.label: Sender email
fields.help: The address sign-in email comes from. Your mail provider must allow sending from it.

presentations.label: Run Edit Run mail key
presentations.help: Filled in by Managed hosting. It lets this app send its own sign-in email and can be replaced at any time.

presentations.label: Resend API key
presentations.help: From your Resend account, with permission to send email.

presentations.label: SendGrid API key
presentations.help: From your SendGrid account, with permission to send email.

fields.name: APP_URL
fields.label: App web address
fields.help: Where people open Slate, such as https://wiki.example.com. Hosting fills this in.

fields.name: PUBLIC_PAGE_HOST
fields.label: Web address for published pages
fields.help: Where pages you publish for anyone to read are served. Hosting fills this in.

fields.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER
fields.label: Company sign-in address
fields.help: Optional. The web address of your company's sign-in service, so people can sign in with their work account. Leave blank to sign in with email links. The owner confirms it by email before it takes effect.

fields.name: SLATE_PROFILE
fields.label: Feature set

options.label: Team wiki plus features in development (for developers)

fields.help: Team wiki is Slate. The other choice adds features still being built, for developers working on Slate; it gives nobody extra access.

fields.name: AI_ENABLED
fields.label: AI assistant (for developers)
fields.help: Turns on Slate's AI features, which are still being built. Needs an AI service key. Keep it off for everyday use.

fields.name: AI_PROVIDER
fields.label: AI service (for developers)
fields.help: Which AI service the assistant uses when it is on.

fields.name: ALLOW_LOOPBACK_DELEGATION
fields.label: Connect to apps on this computer (for developers)
fields.help: Lets Slate's connectors reach a Happy To Help or Orbit app running at localhost while you develop them. Keep it off on a hosted app.

fields.name: SSO_ENABLED
fields.label: Company sign-in (for developers)
fields.help: Turns on sign-in through a company identity service configured with extra deployment settings.

fields.name: LINK_PREVIEWS_ENABLED
fields.label: Link previews
fields.help: When someone pastes a web link into a page, Slate fetches the page's title and summary to show a preview card.
